config.storageback.title: Storage & Back
config.storageback.balancing_changes.too: Recipes that change vanilla balance: Amethyst Block → 4 Amethyst Shards and Magma Block → 4 Magma Cream.
config.storageback.back_recipes.tooltip: All recipes that turn vanilla blocks back into their items (Quartz Block → 4 Nether Quartz, Bricks → 4 Bricks, ...).
config.storageback.reload_note: Recipes are server data: applies after /reload or rejoining the world. On a server, edit config/storageback.json there.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.storageba: Storage blocks for flint, sugar cane, charcoal, gunpowder, blaze rods, leather, feathers, ender pearls, rotten flesh and crops, plus recipes that turn vanilla blocks back into their items.
item.storageback.guide_book.desc: A guide to the new blocks and recipes
book.storageback.page.title:
A guide to the new storage blocks, how to craft them, the back (uncrafting) recipes, and the config toggles.

Crafted from 1 Book and 1 Flint Block, shapeless.
book.storageback.page.flint_block:
Crafted from 9 Flint in a 3×3 grid.
Crafts back into 9 Flint.

A stone-like block.
Needs a pickaxe to mine.
book.storageback.page.sugar_cane_bundle:
Crafted from 9 Sugar Cane in a 3×3 grid.
Crafts back into 9 Sugar Cane.

Rotates like a log.
Burns. Compostable.
book.storageback.page.charcoal_block:
Crafted from 9 Charcoal in a 3×3 grid.
Crafts back into 9 Charcoal.

Furnace fuel: smelts 80 items, the same as a Block of Coal.
Burns.
book.storageback.page.gunpowder_block:
Crafted from 9 Gunpowder in a 3×3 grid.
Crafts back into 9 Gunpowder.

Falls like sand.
Does not explode.
book.storageback.page.blaze_rod_bundle:
Crafted from 9 Blaze Rods in a 3×3 grid.
Crafts back into 9 Blaze Rods.

Rotates like a log.
Gives off a little light (level 5).
Furnace fuel: smelts 108 items.
book.storageback.page.leather_block:
Crafted from 9 Leather in a 3×3 grid.
Crafts back into 9 Leather.

A soft, wool-like block with stitching.
Burns.
book.storageback.page.feather_block:
Crafted from 9 Feathers in a 3×3 grid.
Crafts back into 9 Feathers.

Landing on it deals only 20% fall damage, like a Hay Bale.
Burns.
book.storageback.page.ender_pearl_block:
Crafted from 9 Ender Pearls in a 3×3 grid; crafts back into 9.

A cluster of 9 touching pearls (8 at the corners, 1 in the centre) that you can see between.
They only stack to 16; this stores 9 per slot.
book.storageback.page.rotten_flesh_block:
Crafted from 9 Rotten Flesh in a 3×3 grid.
Crafts back into 9 Rotten Flesh.

Handy storage for mob farms.
Compostable.
book.storageback.page.carrot_crate:
Crafted from 9 Carrots in a 3×3 grid.
Crafts back into 9 Carrots.

A wooden crate. Mine it with an axe.
Burns. Compostable.
book.storageback.page.potato_crate:
Crafted from 9 Potatoes in a 3×3 grid.
Crafts back into 9 Potatoes.

A wooden crate. Mine it with an axe.
Burns. Compostable.
book.storageback.page.beetroot_crate:
Crafted from 9 Beetroots in a 3×3 grid.
Crafts back into 9 Beetroots.

A wooden crate. Mine it with an axe.
Burns. Compostable.
book.storageback.page.apple_crate:
Crafted from 9 Apples in a 3×3 grid.
Crafts back into 9 Apples.

A wooden crate. Mine it with an axe.
Burns. Compostable.
book.storageback.page.back_intro:
One block, crafted shapeless, gives back the items it is made from.

Recipes marked * can be turned off in the config.
Dark Prismarine loses the black dye.
book.storageback.page.back_1:
(1/5)
Block of Quartz →
4 Nether Quartz
Block of Amethyst →
4 Amethyst Shards *
Clay →
4 Clay Balls

Edit storageback.json in config, or Mod Menu, then /reload.
